question: Duties and responsibilities of captain of the ship?
text:
The **captain**, also called the **master**, has overall command of the ship and is responsible for its safe operation and the safety of its crew, passengers, and cargo. Officers carry out many day-to-day tasks, but the captain retains overall responsibility. ([bls.gov](https://www.bls.gov/OOH/transportation-and-material-moving/water-transportation-occupations.htm?utm_source=openai))

| Main duty | What it involves |
|---|---|
| **Navigate safely** | Approve the voyage plan, oversee bridge watches, and adjust course or speed for weather, traffic, and other hazards. ([onetonline.org](https://www.onetonline.org/link/summary/53-5021.00?utm_source=openai)) |
| **Lead the crew** | Give clear orders, assign duties through officers, and make sure the crew knows what to do in routine operations and emergencies. ([bls.gov](https://www.bls.gov/OOH/transportation-and-material-moving/water-transportation-occupations.htm?utm_source=openai)) |
| **Keep the ship fit for the voyage** | Oversee the ship’s condition and safety equipment, and ensure cargo is safely loaded and secured without compromising stability. ([onetonline.org](https://www.onetonline.org/link/summary/53-5021.00?utm_source=openai)) |
| **Prepare for and lead emergencies** | Ensure drills are held and direct the response to fires, flooding, medical emergencies, or evacuation. ([wwwcdn.imo.org](https://wwwcdn.imo.org/localresources/en/KnowledgeCentre/IndexofIMOResolutions/AssemblyDocuments/A.741%2818%29.pdf?utm_source=openai)) |
| **Prevent pollution and ensure compliance** | Implement the ship’s safety and pollution-prevention procedures, oversee required records, and ensure incidents are reported. ([wwwcdn.imo.org](https://wwwcdn.imo.org/localresources/en/KnowledgeCentre/IndexofIMOResolutions/AssemblyDocuments/A.741%2818%29.pdf?utm_source=openai)) |

A key point: **the captain has overriding authority to make decisions about safety and pollution prevention**. For example, the captain can delay departure if conditions make sailing unsafe. ([wwwcdn.imo.org](https://wwwcdn.imo.org/localresources/en/KnowledgeCentre/IndexofIMOResolutions/AssemblyDocuments/A.741%2818%29.pdf?utm_source=openai))
